endorsements.label: CVE-2021-34597
endorsements.description: Improper Input Validation vulnerability in PC Worx Automation Suite of Phoenix Contact up to version 1.88 could allow an attacker with a manipulated project file to unpack arbitrary files outside of the selected project directory.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.8)
